source_read: https://menus.tenkites.com/nwtc/thebotanist (18 menus, each page downloaded fresh 2026-10-08; robots.txt disallows only /fonts/, /views/ and *.less)
not_verifiable: the pages print calories only (no protein, carbs, fat, salt or kJ), so no other nutrients exist to compare; drinks print no calories
notes: The live menu list had changed since the 6-8 Oct build (16 -> 18 menus: new 'Group Dining Celebration Menu - From November 18th' and 'Beaujolais Day Set Menu', Pizza menu re-issued with a new id, Christmas menu listed as 'Christmas Set Menu'): the_botanist.py was updated (MENUS, counts, LIST_NAMES) and re-run, so 4 pizza calories changed (Margherita 545->578, Goats Cheese & Pesto 780->797, Pepperoni 671->704, Ham & Mushroom 619->652) and 7 items were added (2 Christmas pizzas, 3 pizza dips, 8oz Sirloin Steak x2 menus; 8oz Sirloin Steak lost its plain id). All 169 rows then matched an independent html.parser read of the pages on kcal, 14 allergen columns and vegetarian tags. Four aioli/mayonnaise/vegan-cheesecake flags marked ok (Vegan column ticked).
